notes.title: Dead Hungry Diner 1.11 Update
notes.content:
Some more bug fixes

Fixed resource leak causing game to hang when playing a long time
Fixed potential crash when script code returns an error
Fixed OK button in loading error screen
Fixed wrong and/or badly selected display size in fallback screen size selection code
Removed a SetCurosPos call in hope it fixes the "cursor snaps to screen center" issue some players reported (but also read this for Win8.1. And also this on WoW for a similar issue)

notes.title: Dead Hungry Diner 1.10 Update
notes.content:
This is mainly a bug fix release dealing with invalid resolutions and problems with integrated graphics and other low end graphics chips.


Fix: Bug in reading desktop size sometimes leading to non-displayable resolutions
Fix: Allowing only resolution less or equal than desktop dimensions
Fix: No (broken) screen scaling with Intel Integrated Graphics
Change: Using fixed function pipeline when available to deal with broken shader implementations in driver
Add: Options to disable screen scaling and disable use of realtime shader system
Add: Alternate name "config.txt.txt" for config.txt file
Add: Message box to validate game starts (Hold shift when starting the game)
Fix: Positioned some artwork and hit boxes for stretched screen layout
Add: Some more possible screen resolutions for 16:9 displays
Change: When scaling up screen higher game view resolution are preferred (Display game elements in full when possible)

notes.title: Dead Hungry Diner Beta 1.9 started (We need your feedback!)
notes.content:
What's new:
- Achievements
- Leaderboards for All-You-Can eat levels
- Changed difficulty for All-You-Can-Eat levels

You can play the beta version using the Games Properties 'Beta' tab.

WARNING: 
- The saved games of the new version are not backwards compatible to the latest release version. So you loose all saved games if you decide to go back to the 1.8 version after playing the beta. 
- The All-You-Can-Eat modes are still tweaked and leaderboards might be wiped a few times before the final version goes live. This does NOT impact any achievements earned.
 
We need your help!
The All-You-Can-Eat levels are still pretty unbalanced. But if enough people play them we can tweak difficulty using the leaderboard information. So please try them! Also feel free to post feedback into the forums. Thanks!

notes.title: Dead Hungry Diner 1.8 Update
notes.content:
Fullscreen mode completely redone: Less black borders!
Added all the polish and little fixes from the iOS version to the PC version (for the iOS version see here)
Fixed single click sometimes reported as a double click (and killing a streak sometimes :-( )
Changed DRM wrapper. Should fix cases where game wouldn't start in Steam client but worked as DRM free version.
Sprites grouped in texture atlases and use of hardware texture compression for better support of low spec machines
Added user config file with additional options (for example to fix a missing mouse cursor). These options are published on the Community Forum

notes.title: Dead Hungry Diner 1.8 Beta (Full Game and Demo)
notes.content:
(Information on how to join beta at the end of this announcement)

Changes:

- Fullscreen mode completely redone. Less black borders.
- Changed DRM wrapper. Should fix cases where game wouldn't start in Steam client but worked as DRM free version.
- Added all the polish and little fixes done for the iPhone/iPad version to the PC version
- Fixed single click sometimes reported as a double click
- Sprites grouped in texture atlases and support of hardware texture compression to better support very low endish machines
- Added user config file with additional config options (for example to fix the missing mouse cursor). These options will be published soon in the Support Forum 


To enable the beta version: 

- Right mouse button click on Dead Hungry Diner/Dead Hungry Diner Demo in Games Library and choose "Properties"
- Go to "Beta" tab and enter "brainberries" as beta access code. Click "Check Code"
- Select "Beta - Public beta" from the drop down list
You can revert back by choosing "NONE - Opt out of all beta programs"


Please report any problems to the Support forum!

notes.title: Dead Hungry Diner Update Released
notes.content:
Dead Hungry Diner 1.5 Update 

NEW: 
- Permanently lowered price
- Three new monster customers: Mummy Girl, Skelley the skeleton lady and the Crazy Werewolf
- New "affection" game mechanic: Some monsters admire some other monsters so much that they do not engage in a fight
- Level selection screen: You can replay any level you have played before to get all three stars (with all upgrades you bought so far)
- Shady, the shop keeper, now only accepts stars as currency to buy upgrades!
- Moved from save slots to player profiles
- Levels are reworked with the new features
- Artwork polished
- Website refurbished (http://www.deadhungrydiner.com)

notes.title: Dead Hungry Diner Update Released
notes.content:
1.2 Patch Notes: Dead Hungry Diner
NEW: 3 Difficulty modes to choose from (Casual, Expert, Master) with ability to skip/fast track introductory levels
NEW: Localization added for the following languages.
    - French
    - German
    - Irish
    - Italian
    - Spanish
NEW: Help screen added to the main menu
NEW: Language selection screen added to main menu
NEW: Task Indicators that show queued player actions
NEW: Selected monsters now pulse in the queue
NEW: Ability to deselect a queue or spell by clicking on it again
FIX: Mouse disappearing at start of game
FIX: Right mouse button problems
FIX: Upper middle table was unclickable in certain circumstances.
FIX: Some in game dialogue had been missing. The events that fire these are now fixed
CHANGED: Some audio has been tuned down (Vampire Hiss, Coin "ping")
